title: Coupon
description: Promotional coupon code that customers can apply for discounts. Tracks coupon code, discount rules, usage limits, validity period, and redemption statistics.

code.description: Unique alphanumeric coupon code that customers enter at checkout (e.g., SAVE20, WELCOME10)

description.description: Marketing description explaining what the coupon offers

discount_type.description: Type of discount (e.g., percentage, fixed_amount, free_shipping)

discount_value.description: Discount amount - percentage (e.g., 20) or fixed amount depending on discount_type

min_purchase.description: Minimum purchase amount required to use this coupon

max_discount.description: Maximum discount amount that can be applied, used to cap percentage discounts

currency.description: ISO currency code for monetary values (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

usage_limit.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be used across all customers

used_count.description: Number of times this coupon has been successfully applied

valid_from.description: Date when the coupon becomes active and can be used

valid_until.description: Expiration date after which the coupon is no longer valid

active.description: Whether the coupon is currently active and available for use
